subject.title: build(deps): bump the android-deps group across 1 directory with 2 updates

question: After the current-head Android build, lint, and test matrix completes, should the Android area accept the Kotlin 2.4.10 compiler-plugin upgrade?
rationale: The update changes compiler plugins shared by Android Compose and serialization builds; passing generic guards cannot determine project-specific Gradle/compiler compatibility.

options.title: Accept after Android matrix
options.body: Merge after the current-head Android build, lint, and test lanes pass and the Android-area reviewer accepts the Kotlin upgrade.

options.title: Hold at 2.4.0
options.body: Close or defer the update if the Android matrix exposes an incompatible Compose, serialization, or Gradle behavior that requires a coordinated upgrade.

recommendation.title: Accept after Android matrix
recommendation.body: Merge after the current-head Android build, lint, and test lanes pass and the Android-area reviewer accepts the Kotlin upgrade.
